goal: Implement velm_date(day) in velm_calendar.py that converts a day count (day 1 = 1-01-01) into a Velm calendar date of 13 months of 28 days, with a Hollow day ending each long year, and raises ValueError for day below 1.
behaviors: velm_date(5) returns "1-01-05" (day 1 is the first day of year 1; month and day are two digits).
velm_date(30) returns "1-02-02" and velm_date(363) returns "1-13-27" (months have 28 days, 13 per year).
velm_date(730) returns "3-01-02" (an ordinary year has 364 days).
velm_date(1821) returns "5-HOLLOW" and velm_date(2000) returns "6-07-11" (a year divisible by 5 is long and ends with Hollow).
velm_date(32775) returns "90-13-28" and velm_date(163877) returns "450-13-28", while velm_date(163878) returns "450-HOLLOW" (a year divisible by 30 is not long unless it is divisible by 150).

assumptions.text: velm_calendar.py exists at the repo root as the single flat module.
The tests/ directory exists for the new test file.
pyproject.toml exists so the project toolchain is configured.
pytest can be run through uv without network access.

demo: python -c 'from velm_calendar import velm_date; print(velm_date(365)); print(velm_date(1821))'
out_of_scope: Converting dates back to day counts

invariants.text: a date is Hollow or has a month from 1 to 13 and a day from 1 to 28
every year has at least 364 days, so the year is at most (day - 1) // 364 + 1
